prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["Personalize Companion Routine", "Select daily focus habits your desktop pet will assist you with throughout your day.", "Select Focus Activity"]
2: ["Test Companion Desktop Sounds", "Sample audio alerts and pet voice clips before completing onboarding.", "Continue to Desktop", "Sample Pet Alert Sound"]
3: ["Official Adoption Ceremony", "Click the stamp button to apply your official adoption seal.", "Stamp Official Seal"]
4: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Press Alt+P anytime to summon or hide your pet. Click your pet on desktop for full controls.", "Launch Pet (Alt+P)"]
5: ["Secure Your Pet & Unlock Cozy Playroom", "Sign in to back up your companion and instantly receive the Cozy Playroom desktop skin.", "Unlocked on Sign-In: Cozy Playroom"]
6: ["Protect Your Pet's Data & Memory", "Signing in secures your companion's memory and stats so they are never reset or lost.", "Sign In to Save Companion"]
7: ["Upload Pet Photo & Claim Crown Accessory", "Upload a photo of your pet to receive an exclusive Crown accessory upon adoption.", "Bonus Accessory: Golden Crown"]
8: ["Preparing Desktop Pet Assets...", "Test pet animations while your desktop companion loads.", "Trigger Wave Animation"]
9: ["Pick Your Companion's Desktop Corner", "Select where on your screen your pet should spend most of its time.", "Select Primary Screen Corner"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras or gifts tied to signing in.
Offers a bonus extra/gift for providing a photo.
